Package eu.cloudhopper.mc.annotations

Annotation Interface Function

@Retention(SOURCE) @Target(METHOD) public @interface Function
Marks a method as a deployable cloud function.

The annotated method is discovered during annotation processing, which generates the provider-specific CloudRequestHandler and the deployment artifacts for it — you no longer implement that interface yourself. Combine @Function with a trigger such as HttpTrigger or ScheduledTrigger, and bind the method parameters with RequestBody, PathParam, QueryParam or HeaderParam.

Example: 


 @Function(name = "hello")
 @HttpTrigger(method = "GET", path = "/hello/{name}")
 public String hello(@PathParam("name") String name) {
     return "Hello, " + name;
 }
